When a customer renews fewer licences, what changes in your success plan?

I'm interested in the work that gets kept, narrowed or stopped, not just the new forecast.

A smaller renewal can leave both teams working from an old plan.

Pick one workflow and agree whether to keep it, narrow it or pause it. Check the help that's actually agreed before changing the promise.

The one-page plan reset is here:

A plan can get more useful when you remove something from it.

If the customer's priorities or capacity have changed, leaving every old milestone in place doesn't preserve the ambition. It can leave people trying to deliver work nobody can support.

I'd name what's stopping and what would need to change before it restarts.
